t: You're at Crescent Grove, a crescent-shaped garden square in Clapham, in the London Borough of Lambeth. William Hibbert, who lived from 1759 to 1844, lived here. He was a merchant and planter, and a partner in the West India house of Geo. Rob. and Wm. Hibbert, alongside his brother George and his cousin Robert. The firm handled the shipping, insurance and distribution of sugar from the West Indies. It was also involved in the slave trade, and Hibbert is described as a slave trader.
